integrity: Exact formula and unrestricted inductive proof; a standalone checker independently constructs transforms through rank fourteen. Computational tests supplement, rather than replace, the induction.
scientific_limitations: No claim for arbitrary prefix lengths, other paperfolding variants, sentinel-terminated transforms, or independent mathematical validation. Historical priority may be incomplete.
scope: Sentinel-free cyclic Burrows–Wheeler transform of complete dyadic regular-paperfolding prefixes of rank at least six; binary alphabet in order zero then one.
title: Exact circular Burrows–Wheeler transform of dyadic paperfolding prefixes
